detail.longDescription:
Control your Smart TV effortlessly with iMote — the ultimate universal remote control for TV. This advanced application transforms your smartphone into a highly responsive smart TV remote, replacing traditional physical controllers.

Use iMote when your physical remote is lost, broken, or inconvenient. Connect your phone with your smart TV and start controlling your TV in seconds.

💡 BEST SUITED FOR USERS WHO WANT TO:

- Manage multiple television sets effortlessly from one universal remote control dashboard.
- Replace lost or damaged physical remote controls with our instant digital remote app.
- Navigate complex smart interfaces using an intuitive phone keyboard and gestures.
- Stream local media directly to big screens when connected to the same Wi-Fi network.
- Cast photos, videos, and music from phone to TV.

FREE FEATURES:

📺 UNIVERSAL REMOTE CONTROL FOR TV
✔️ Control all major smart TV brands with a single, unified universal tv remote control solution: Samsung, Fire TV, LG, Roku, Vizio, Sony, TCL, Hisense, Philips, Panasonic, Insignia, Element, RCA, Sanyo, Sharp, Toshiba, and Onn.
✔️ Universal Platform Compatibility: This smart TV remote offers native support for all popular platforms including WebOS (LG), Roku OS, Android TV / Google TV, Tizen (Samsung), and SmartCast (Vizio).
✔️ Essential Navigation Control: Manage your television effortlessly using our smart TV remote features, including power toggles, precise tv volume control (featuring instant tv volume up commands), input switching, and a full numeric keypad within this remote app.

✨ SCREEN MIRRORING & SMART CAST TO TV
✔️ Stream videos, photos, and music from your device directly to your smart display with low latency.
✔️ Mirror your phone screen to your big television in real-time for presentations, gaming, or media sharing.
✔️ Compatible with all major smart TV brands and platforms.

🎛️ INTUITIVE TV CONTROL UTILITIES
✔️ Touchpad Navigation: Move through complex menus smoothly using simple swipe, tap, and scroll motions.
✔️ Playback Commands: Effortlessly manage your streaming media with dedicated buttons for play, pause, fast-forward, and rewind.
✔️ Keyboard Input: Type text quickly when searching for movies or entering login credentials on your television interface.

PREMIUM FEATURES:
✔️ No Ads: Enjoy an uninterrupted, ad-free environment.
✔️ Advanced User Controls: Unlock customizable button layouts and pro navigation features for a truly personalized TV remote experience.
✔️ Priority Customer Support: Access fast, high-priority assistance for any setup questions.

🔌 SMART TV CONNECTION & SETUP:
✔️ Seamless Wi-Fi Sync: Connect your smart television and Android device to the same Wi-Fi network to enable instant smart TV remote functionality.
✔️ Enhanced Compatibility: Automatically detect your smart TV devices, ensuring a stable, low-latency connection for all major TV brands.

WHY iMOTE
✔️ Built for your smart TV. All remote features are consolidated into this single, powerful application to replace multiple physical controllers.
✔️ It makes everyday TV use faster and easier than a physical remote.
✔️ Designed for simple, unified control of your entire home entertainment setup.

Take your home entertainment to the next level with iMote — the universal TV remote that combines simplicity, power, and smart TV remote features in one app. Download iMote for FREE or upgrade to Premium for full TV access to all pro features.

DISCLAIMER:
This application is an independent development, compatible with the mentioned brands or companies, but it is not officially related to or associated with them in any way. All brand names and trademarks are used strictly to describe device compatibility.

CONTACT:
For support please contact us at: info@imote.app
Terms of use: https://imote.app/terms-of-use
Privacy policy: https://imote.app/privacy-policy

Download iMote now and enjoy total universal TV remote control convenience!
